purpose: Separate verified live database schema from migration-declared intent so runtime contracts never promote unverified tables to LIVE truth.

states.LIVE_VERIFIED: Present in the dated live-schema snapshot.
states.MIGRATION_DECLARED_UNVERIFIED: Declared by repository SQL but absent from the dated live-schema snapshot.
states.UNKNOWN: Referenced without sufficient live or migration evidence.
states.BOTH: Declared by repository SQL and present in the dated live-schema snapshot.

rules: live-schema.json is evidence, not a target schema.
Migration declarations never upgrade runtime truth to LIVE_VERIFIED.
A table absent from live-schema.json must not be queried as a verified live source.
Generated drift reports retain capture date and project reference.
Failed or unavailable live inspection must not be converted into an empty schema.
Schema changes require a refreshed live evidence snapshot before LIVE_VERIFIED status is assigned.
